sloka: दैत्यैर्निशाचरैश्चैव स रथः परिवारितः ।समराभिमुखो दैत्यो महेन्द्रं सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। ७.२८.३१ ॥
transliteration: daityairniśācaraiścaiva sa rathaḥ parivāritaḥ ।samarābhimukho daityo mahendraṁ so 'bhyavartata ।। 7.28.31 ॥

translations.english: Surrounded by demons and night-wanderers, that chariot, with the demon facing the battle, advanced towards Mahendra.
